editorial:
Imagine you are obsessed with true crime and will do anything to get a hit story. That is exactly where you find Kat, a podcast host who is desperate for a big break. She pulls her influencer friend Deana into a messy situation when she finds a lead about a secret witch coven. The movie feels like a wild ride where a modern obsession with social media meets old-school spooky rituals. It starts off feeling like a fun mystery, but it quickly turns into a fight for survival as the girls realize they are in way over their heads. 

What really works here is the chemistry between the two lead actresses, which makes the scary parts feel more real. The plot moves quickly, though some of the twists might feel a bit sudden. If you love movies where curious people find things they should have left alone, you will dig this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover that the coven was not just acting out of malice, but were trying to stop a greater evil. The big twist is that Kat's obsession with fame actually triggered the final ritual. Deana barely escapes, but Kat ends up becoming part of the very occult world she tried to exploit for her podcast. It ends on a dark note, showing that curiosity can sometimes cost you everything.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime podcasts and supernatural mysteries.
